fields.System.Title: FDN-702 — Partners
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a system administrator, I want suppliers, customers, and carriers recorded as
partners, so that receipts, orders, and shipments can reference who they involve.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a partner, then it has one or more roles: supplier, customer, or carrier.
  • - Given a partner code, then it is unique.
  • - Given a customer, then their address and any fulfilment rules (partial shipment
  • allowed, minimum shelf life required) are recorded.
  • - Given a partner in use, then it can be deactivated but not deleted.
